nodes.description: Your agent has agents. A self-hosted, local-first AI agent platform in one Go binary: agents hand work to specialists and build the tools, agents and apps they lack, with sandboxed tools and credentials the model never sees.

nodes.title: getmodern-ai/graft
nodes.description: Graft writes the API integration your agent is missing, on demand, and serves it over MCP. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Hermes or OpenClaw; the model reads the vendor docs, writes and verifies a small tool, and the proxy injects the credential so it never reaches the code. Self-hostable with Docker and Postgres.
